create_riemannian_ode_solver: create a RiemannianODESolver with a Sphere manifold and a velocity model
sample_euler_integration: sample from the solver using Euler integration with a given step size and time grid
sample_rk4_integration: sample from the solver using RK4 integration over a specified time grid
sample_return_intermediates: sample from the solver and return intermediate states at each time grid point
sample_with_gradient: sample from the solver with gradient tracking enabled for backpropagation through the ODE solve
